description: Events for the watchlist after a cursor, oldest first: bankruptcies, compositions, debt enforcement, liquidations, deletions, register deficiencies and changes, and new entries published in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB), each with a link to the notice and its signed PDF. Keep next_cursor and pass it as cursor next time: every event comes exactly once. historical "true" filters the findings of the initial check, published before the entry was added.
name: events_list
title: List events
